section.sectionSummaryBrief: Based on this, the inner reason for the two revelations of Sovev and Memaleh is that they correspond to Torah and Mitzvos, and to intellect and will in Israel.
section.t: And based on this, it can be said,
that the inner reason for this, that the two revelations of Sovev and Memaleh were drawn down,
the revelation of the Essence and the revelation to illuminate the worlds,
is because in Torah and Israel there are parallels to these two matters.
For these two matters in Torah are Torah and Mitzvos,
and in Israel they are intellect and will
[for that which in the human soul there is intellect and emotions is primarily in Israel,
"You are called Adam"47,
and from this it descends also to the nations of the world].
And based on this it can be said, that which the Maamar brings a parable for Sovev and Memaleh from will and intellect in man,
and in continuation of this, the explanation of the difference between Mitzvos and Torah,
is
(also)
in order to hint that the root of the two revelations
(the revelation of the Essence and the revelation to illuminate the worlds)
is
(like)
these two matters that are in Torah and Israel.
And this adds to the understanding of the superiority of the two aforementioned revelations,
that in them there is not only the aspect of revelation, but also a parallel to the matters of Torah and Israel, whose root is in the Awtsmoos.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The arousal from Above that comes spontaneously to stimulate arousal from below originates from a place that arousal from below cannot reach, and this is explained through its parallel to Israel.
section.t: And based on this, we can explain that which is known48,
that the arousal from Above that is drawn from itself in order to arouse arousal from below comes from a place that arousal from below does not reach.
For seemingly, explanation is needed,
behold, that arousal from below does not reach there is because relative to this level, the lower does not occupy space
[and one should add,
that this lack of spatial grasp of the creations relative to this level is because the root of Sovev
(from which this arousal from Above is drawn)
is the light whose matter is not to illuminate the worlds, but rather the revelation of the Essence],
and how is arousal from Above drawn from there in order to arouse arousal from below?
And according to the above, it can be said,
that by means of this, that the light which is the revelation of the Essence is parallel to this matter that is in Israel,
through this it is felt that its intention is for the sake of Israel.
Therefore, arousal from Above is drawn from it in order to arouse arousal from below.
And one should add,

that through the drawing down of the arousal from Above to arouse the arousal from below, an additional elevation is added in the arousal from Above and in the place from which the arousal from Above is drawn.
For49
through this, the intention within it is revealed even more,
and also that it is parallel to a matter in Israel, whose root is in the Awtsmoos.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: The written form "Mah" and the read form "Me'ah" indicate the concealment of the soul's Mah and the revelation of Me'ah, with the written form pointing to the essential concealment of the Awtsmoos.
section.t: And this is "And now, Israel, what [Mah]..." — do not read it as Mah but as Me'ah,
for that which the written form is Mah and the read form is Me'ah,
the written and the read are concealment and revelation50,
it is,
that Me'ah is Sovev,
and in its root, the light of the revelation of the Essence — revelation,
and Mah is the Mah of the soul,
which is in concealment.
For by the soul becoming a created being51,
the Mah within it is in concealment
(and in order for it to come to revelation, it is through the drawing down of the aspect of Me'ah,
as above, sections 3 and 4).
And behold, this concealment is lower than revelation.
And according to the known principle52
that the written form is above the read form,
it can be said,
that the concealment of the Mah of the soul, which is hinted at in that Mah is the written form,
is that the soul is rooted in the essential concealment of the Awtsmoos.
And one should add,
that this, that Me'ah is the read form of the written form Mah,
is,
that through the drawing down of Me'ah to arouse the Mah,
it is felt within it
(as above, end of section 8)
that it is a parallel and revelation of the Mah of Israel.
